itens.titulo: OpenAI agents analyze mouse brain data in 32 minutes, a job that would take humans months
itens.resumo: OpenAI teamed up with PerturbAI and Scripps Research to deploy thousands of AI agents that analyzed biological data from millions of mouse cells. The article OpenAI agents analyze mouse brain data in 32 minutes, a job that would take humans months appeared first on The Decoder .
